title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 7: a letter they had written, concession and commandment, each man's own gift, callings, and the mode of this world.

questions.text: How does verse 1 introduce the subject of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 begins, "Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me".

answers.text: As a command he received in a vision
As a report brought by Timothy
As a tradition handed down by the apostles
As a reply to things they had written to him

questions.text: What reason does verse 5 give for a season agreed on by consent?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is so that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer.

answers.text: So that they may travel to other cities
So that they may give themselves to fasting and prayer
So that they may settle their lawsuits
So that they may keep the feast

questions.text: How does the writer describe what he has just said in verse 6?
questions.explanation: He says he says it by way of concession, not of commandment.

answers.text: As a concession, not a commandment
As a commandment from the Lord
As a word of prophecy
As a tradition of the assemblies

questions.text: What does verse 7 say each man has from God?
questions.explanation: The verse says each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind and another of that kind.

answers.text: His own calling to teach
His own household
His own gift
His own measure of wisdom

questions.text: In verse 10, who does the writer say gives this command to the married?
questions.explanation: He says, "not I, but the Lord", that the wife not leave her husband.

answers.text: The writer himself, not the Lord
The elders of the assembly
The law of Moses
The Lord, not the writer himself

questions.text: What does verse 14 say about the children?
questions.explanation: The verse says that otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

answers.text: They are unclean
They are holy
They are not spoken of
They must be taught the law

questions.text: According to verse 19, what matters rather than circumcision or uncircumcision?
questions.explanation: The verse says circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

answers.text: The traditions of the fathers
The judgment of the assembly
The keeping of the commandments of God
The gift of prophecy

questions.text: What does verse 21 say to one who was called as a bondservant and gets an opportunity to become free?
questions.explanation: The verse says not to let that bother him, but if he gets an opportunity to become free, to use it.

answers.text: To use the opportunity
To refuse the opportunity
To ask the assembly first
To wait for the Lord to come

questions.text: What does the writer say about his words concerning virgins in verse 25?
questions.explanation: He says he has no commandment from the Lord, but gives his judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

answers.text: That he has a commandment from the Lord
That he has no commandment from the Lord, but gives his own judgment
That he was told this by the other apostles
That he is repeating what they wrote to him

questions.text: According to verse 39, how long is a wife bound by law?
questions.explanation: The verse says a wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives.

answers.text: Until the Lord comes
For one year
Until she is past the flower of her age
As long as her husband lives
